description: Private requirement-level writing task alignment evaluation dataset.

notes.task_context: Canonical src.tasks task context. task_id must match the record.
notes.content_rights_status: Explicit permission or restriction status for prompts and source material.

notes.original_text: Exact uncorrected learner response; private and local-only.
notes.response_family_id: Stable identifier shared by revisions of one response.
notes.analysis_schema_version: Version of src.analysis used to bind reference assessments.

notes.alignment_assessment: Canonical src.alignment assessment with a human assessor and exact evidence offsets.
notes.annotation_origin: Whether the reference was direct human review or model-assisted human adjudication.

split_constraints: A participant cannot cross development and sealed_evaluation roles.
A response family cannot cross dataset roles.
Development data cannot later be called untouched evaluation data.
